card_sentences: SAMPLE Two cousins in Sunset Park started roasting chickpeas in a rented kitchen in 2022. They wanted a crunchy, savory snack that tastes like their grandmother's cooking.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE CONTAINS: WHEAT, MILK, EGG, SOY, SESAME, PEANUTS AND TREE NUTS (ALMONDS, CASHEWS, WALNUTS, PECANS, PISTACHIOS, HAZELNUTS), FISH (ANCHOVY) AND CRUSTACEAN SHELLFISH (SHRIMP, CRAB) FROM SEASONING.
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE MAY CONTAIN MUSTARD, CELERY AND OATS. MADE IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES OTHER TREE NUTS AND LUPIN.
retailer_line: SAMPLE Whole Foods Market Union Square, 4 Union Square South
